exposure: Parity (primiparous, multiparous with no previous cesarean, multiparous with a previous cesarean)
Socioeconomic position at 12 years of age (SEP-12)
socioeconomic position at 12 years of age
finding: The association between SEP-12 and cesarean rates suggests the effect of past socioeconomic context on the decision concerning the mode of delivery, but only among women who experienced a previous cesarean.
mod_finding: Among multiparous women with a previous cesarean section, those from higher socioeconomic positions at age 12 were more likely to have another cesarean delivery.
